clocks.formal_schedule: source clock toggles every formal microstep; destination clock toggles every second microstep; the safety proof is digital and bounded, not a metastability proof

reset.contract: A reset epoch is coordinated: both resets are asserted before later source acceptance, and neither reset may assert while src_busy is high.
reset.outside_contract: Unilateral reset and reset during an outstanding transaction are unspecified.

acceptance.busy_send: src_send while src_busy is ignored and does not alter the request toggle

delivery.acknowledgement: destination captures the observed request toggle and it returns through a two-stage source synchronizer
delivery.pulse: Exactly one destination registered pulse per accepted source event under the reset contract.
